title: BioTIER: A Refusal Benchmark for Targeted Biological Risk Mitigation

live_model.id_in_text: o4-mini (also o3, o3-pro, o3-mini, GPT-5 family)
live_model.evidence: 'followed by GPT-5 (73.4%), o3 (73.1%), and o4-mini (72.4%)...within OpenAI, o3-pro led at 76.1%'; 'The benchmark consists of 542 expert-curated prompts' organized into Catastrophe Avoidance (CA), Biomedical DURC (BD), and Related Biology (RB) risk tiers

prompt.note: By design, this benchmark's prompts (especially the Catastrophe-Avoidance tier) are curated to probe for genuinely high-risk biological-uplift content; exact prompts are not reproduced here.

claim.location: Results narrative, o4-mini figure (72.4%); 542 expert-curated prompts total across three risk tiers
claim.judge: llm:model grader jury (GPT-4.1 mini, Gemini, others; majority vote)

data.source: BioTIER (542 expert-curated prompts); paper states the benchmark is released, but the highest-risk 'Catastrophe Avoidance' tier content is sensitive by design

notes: This is a legitimate biosecurity-safety benchmark from a credible research group (SecureBio), but re-executing it means sending real biological-risk-uplift probes (its Catastrophe-Avoidance tier is explicitly designed to contain the most dangerous content) to commercial model APIs, which this project does not do. Flagged tos regardless of the benchmark's own research legitimacy.
